title: What If Every Door on Earth Locked for 1 Hour?
sources: Premise is fictional. Supporting mechanics: Encyclopaedia Britannica, lock and key — a spring-latch bolt is held shut by a spring and retracts only when the handle or key turns it
ASME A17.1 Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators — hoistway doors must be interlocked so they stay shut while the car is between floors
Product safety standard BS EN 60335-2-15 — electric kettles are built to shut off automatically once they boil dry

lines.text: You step outside, and every door on Earth clicks shut at once.
lines.caps: You *step outside | every *door on Earth | clicks *shut at once.

lines.text: Elevators freeze right between floors with both doors sealed shut.
lines.caps: Elevators *freeze | right between *floors with | both doors *sealed shut.

lines.text: Shoppers and commuters end up standing on the wrong side of the glass.
lines.caps: Shoppers and *commuters | end up *standing | on the wrong *side | of the *glass.

lines.text: A kettle simmers away behind a kitchen door that nobody can open.
lines.caps: A *kettle | simmers away *behind a | kitchen door that *nobody | can *open.

lines.text: Delivery drivers wait beside idling vans with packages still in hand.
lines.caps: Delivery *drivers | wait beside *idling vans | with *packages still | in *hand.

lines.text: Everyone checks the ground-floor windows, and every one of them holds.
lines.caps: Everyone *checks the | ground-floor *windows, | and every *one of | them *holds.

lines.text: A sixty-minute countdown ticks down on every screen across the city.
lines.caps: A *sixty-minute | countdown *ticks down | on every *screen across | the *city.

lines.text: With ten minutes left, the whole street goes quiet, and everybody just waits.
lines.caps: With ten *minutes left, | the whole *street goes | quiet, and *everybody | just *waits.

lines.text: At one hour exactly, every lock on Earth clicks open together.
lines.caps: At one *hour exactly, | every lock on *Earth | clicks open *together.

lines.text: Except one stuck bathroom latch that won't budge.
lines.caps: Except one *stuck bathroom | latch that *won't budge.
